preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Refund Requests and Statuses'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT r.id AS refundId, l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, r.amount, r.currency_code AS currency, CASE r.status_enum WHEN 100 THEN 'Pending approval' WHEN 200 THEN 'Approved' WHEN 300 THEN 'Payment submitted' WHEN 400 THEN 'Paid' WHEN 450 THEN 'Payment failed' WHEN 500 THEN 'Posted' WHEN 600 THEN 'Rejected' WHEN 700 THEN 'Cancelled' ELSE CAST(r.status_enum AS CHAR) END AS status, CASE r.payment_mode_enum WHEN 1 THEN 'MANUAL' WHEN 2 THEN 'PAYMENT_HUB' ELSE CAST(r.payment_mode_enum AS CHAR) END AS paymentMode, COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.channel')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.submitted.channel'))) AS channel, CASE WHEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.channel')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.submitted.channel'))) = 'MOBILE_MONEY' THEN COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.msisdn')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.submitted.msisdn'))) ELSE COALESCE(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.accountNumber')), JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(r.beneficiary_json, '$.submitted.accountNumber'))) END AS accountOrMsisdn, r.manual_payment_ref AS paymentReference, r.hub_request_id AS hubRequestId, r.paid_on AS paidOn, r.submitted_at AS submittedAt, u.username AS submittedBy FROM m_loan_excess_refund r JOIN m_loan l ON l.id = r.loan_id LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = r.client_id LEFT JOIN m_appuser u ON u.id = r.submitted_by ORDER BY r.submitted_at DESC

preConditions.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stretchy_report WHERE report_name = 'Excess Balance Reconciliation Report'

column.name: report_sql
column.value: SELECT l.account_no AS accountNo, c.display_name AS clientName, l.total_overpaid_derived AS cbsExcess, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum NOT IN (500, 600, 700)), 0) AS openRefundAmount, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum = 500), 0) AS postedRefundAmount, (l.total_overpaid_derived - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(r.amount) FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id AND r.status_enum NOT IN (500, 600, 700)), 0)) AS unreconciledExcess FROM m_loan l LEFT JOIN m_client c ON c.id = l.client_id WHERE l.total_overpaid_derived > 0 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM m_loan_excess_refund r WHERE r.loan_id = l.id) ORDER BY cbsExcess DESC
